import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare the data for visualization

breed_count.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=breed_count, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title

plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Registered Dog Breeds in Zurich')

# Save the figure

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare the data for visualization
breed_count = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).reset_index()
breed_count.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=breed_count, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Registered Dog Breeds in Zurich')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
